native_mechanisms: Lay the two symbol strings crosswise over a tray so their crossings form a lattice of junctions (the pairwise comparison grid).

Send one single cell-wide agent that walks the eight winds, re-testing junctions by doubling back over its own trail, keeping scores only in the grid itself and revisiting until no junction can be improved (ledger-free, backtracking relaxation to a fixed point).
A sideways crossing that costs nothing, letting one cord slip a step ahead of the other (a free gap/indel move).
core_technique: Standard Needleman-Wunsch global-alignment DP computed on anti-diagonal wavefronts with three rolling score buffers and AVX2 int16 SIMD (with scalar int32 anti-diagonal and two-row scalar fallbacks) — a textbook vectorisation, single forward pass, no revisiting and gaps cost -2, not zero.
